page.overview:
Who is Gerrus Bariovon?

Gerrus Bariovon was a human male who worked in Imperial Intelligence of the Galactic Empire during the Imperial Era.

Gerrus Bariovon appeared in the 2025 novel Reign of the Empire: The Mask of Fear, written by Alexander Freed as the first installment of the Star Wars: Reign of the Empire trilogy.
